svg.title: 02 / One workbench, explicit data scopes
svg.desc: Essential workbench concept 02. The same two-pane shell in a dark theme with a filtered, edited synthetic grid: six surfaces mapped to either the original file or the effective edited view. Existing semantics; proposed placement only, EW-02D design output. Static drawing, synthetic data, not a runtime screenshot.
svg.text: STATIC CONCEPT • synthetic data • not a runtime screenshot
Six surfaces, two honest scopes: the file as opened, and the effective edited view. Nothing here is a new data source.
no accepted scope contract · new strings below return for approval

text.tspan: File as opened — never live
edited-view stats
Parsed types for the effective view
Row filter for the grid only
Statistics describe the file as
opened — staged changes are not
included.
Click a value or NULL to filter; a
typed refusal keeps the filter.
Profile = the original file. Grid, Record
and validation = effective edited view; the
grid filter never changes the profile.

g.text: Synthetic sample — one staged edit (row 3 status) is shown from the session overlay; the filter is a grid view only.
Grid view = effective data + accepted filters. Profile includes neither staged edits nor these filters.
row 3 · id 0006 · name Gale Point · status review · amount 33.40 · region west
Record reads the effective logical row (ADR 0011): the staged value is shown, the filter is not a rewrite of data.

text.tspan: Statistics describe the file as opened — staged
changes are not included.
Name the grid filter as well; no origin badge or
revision stamp is added.
Queries run against the supplied table; a result
is one bounded page, not the whole result.
Name that table in the results header; the session
overlay is not applied.
The “Use the open dataset” binding points at the
opened File, not the edited view.
Say that staged edits and the grid filter are not
part of the pipeline source.
A run checks the whole effective dataset and
reports the checked row count.
The grid filter is not applied; edits make the
verdict stale. Say both in the panel.
Preliminary schema and profile evidence compares
the original A and B.
Row diff: effective A versus staged B;
label each stage scope.
Exports the complete edited dataset — all ⟨count⟩
in natural order.
Grid filters and sorting are not applied; ⟨count⟩
is a runtime value elided here.

g.text: STATES · ILLUSTRATIVE COPY PENDING EW-02D — NO METRIC, TIMING OR ROW COUNT IS SHOWN

text.tspan: Empty view: no rows match the current filter;
the scope note stays visible.
Loading: a reading placeholder only — no
earlier statistic is shown as current.
Stale: an edit makes a verdict stale and a
re-run stays explicit; wording pending.
Error: a classified message, with the scope
note still where it was.

svg.text: 1 Retain honest copy → 2 Return the exact per-surface table → 3 Independent review → 4 EW-02I runtime brief only after acceptance
